chapterInfo.content:
21
Ɔbaa kunafoɔ no akyɛdeɛ
(Marko 12.41-44)
1Na ɔmaa n’ani so hunuu adefoɔ a wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ regu ɛtoɔ adaka no mu. 2Na ɔhunuu ɔbaa kunafoɔ hiani bi nso a ɔde mpɛsewa mmienu bɛguu mu. 3#2 Ko 8.12 Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, okunafoɔ hiani yi de bebree abɛgu mu sene wɔn nyinaa. 4Na yeinom nyinaa firi deɛ wɔwɔ na aboro wɔn soɔ no mu na wɔde bi abɛgu mu, nanso oyi deɛ, ɔfiri ne hia mu de n’asetenadeɛ a ɔwɔ nyinaa na abɛgu mu.
Asɔrefie sɛeɛ ho nkɔmhyɛ
(Mateo 24.1-21; Marko 13.1-19)
5Na ebinom reka asɔrefie no ho asɛm sɛdeɛ wɔde abo fɛfɛ ne akyɛdeɛ hodoɔ ahyehyɛ no no, ɔkaa sɛ: 6#Luka 19.44 Nnoɔma a mohunu yi deɛ, nna bi bɛba a wɔrennya ɔboɔ wɔ ɔboɔ so wɔ emu a wɔrennwiri ngu fam.
Nsɛm a ɛdi ɔsɛeɛ yi anim
7Na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, da bɛn na yeinom bɛba, na yeinom rebɛba a, ɛho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne sɛn? 8Na ɔse: Monhwɛ na wɔannaadaa mo, na nnipa bebree bɛba me din mu abɛka sɛ: Mene no, na, Ɛberɛ no abɛn. Na enti monnni wɔn akyi! 9Na sɛ mote ɔko ne basabasayɛ a, mommma no mmɔ mo hu; na ɛtwa sɛ yeinom ba kane; nanso awieeɛ no deɛ, na ɛnnurui.
Akodie ne asasewosoɔ
10Ɛnna ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Ɔman bɛsɔre ɔman so ne ahennie ahennie so. 11Na asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ bɛba mmeammea, na ɛkɔm ne yaredɔm bɛba; na ahudeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akɛseɛ bɛfiri soro aba.
Ɔtaa
12 # Luka 12.11 Na deɛ ɛdi yeinom nyinaa kan ne sɛ wɔde wɔn nsa bɛsɔ mo mu, na wɔataa mo, na wɔayi mo akɔ hyia adan mu ne afiase, na wɔde mo akɔ ahemfo ne amradofoɔ anim me din nti, 13na mode adi me ho adanseɛ.
Ɔgyeɛ
14 # Mat 10.19 Enti momfa nto mo tirim na moannwene deɛ mode bɛyi mo ho ano ansa. 15#Aso 6.10 Na me na mɛma mo ano ne nyansa a mo atamfoɔ nyinaa rentumi ntua ano na wɔrennyina anim. 16Na awofoɔ ne anuanom ne abusuafoɔ ne nnamfo nso bɛyi mo ama, na wɔama wɔakum mo mu binom. 17#Mat 10.21-22 Na me din nti nnipa nyinaa bɛtane mo. 18Na mo tirinwi mu biara mpo renyera. 19#2 Be 15.7; Heb 10.36 Mo boasetɔ mu na mobɛnya mo kra.
Atamfoɔ bɛtwa Yerusalem ho ahyia
20 Na sɛ mohunu sɛ dɔm atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia a, ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ ne sɛeɛ abɛn. 21Ɛnna momma wɔn a wɔwɔ Yudea nnwane nkɔ mmepɔ soɔ, na wɔn a wɔwɔ Yerusalem mfiri mu nkɔ, na wɔn a wɔwɔ nkuraa no, mommma wɔnnkɔ mu, 22#Yer 5.29 ɛfiri sɛ yei ne aweretɔ nna, na nnoɔma a wɔatwerɛ no nyinaa aba mu.
Kuro no sɛeɛ
23 Na wɔn a wɔafa afuro ne wɔn a wɔma nufoɔ nna no mu no nnue! Na ahohia kɛseɛ bɛba asase no so, na abufuo bɛda ɔman yi so. 24#Rom 11.25; Adi 11.2 Na wɔbɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano, na wɔafa wɔn nnommum akɔ amanaman nyinaa so. Na wiase amanaman bɛtiatia Yerusalem so de akɔsi sɛ amanaman no berɛ bɛwie duro.
Onipa ba no ba
(Mateo 24.29-30; Marko 13.24-26)
25 Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bɛba owia ne ɔsrane ne nsoromma mu, na amanaman ho bɛyera wɔn asase so, ɛpo ne asorɔkyeɛ a ɛrehuro no nti; 26na ehu ne nnoɔma a wɔhwɛ a ɛreba wiase no bɛma nnipa atotɔ bera; ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛwoso ɔsoro ahoɔden. 27#Dan 7.13 Ɛnna wɔbɛhunu Onipa Ba no sɛ ɔde tumi ne animuonyam kɛseɛ reba mununkum mu. 28#Flp 4.4-5 Na nnoɔma yi refiri aseɛ aba a, monhwɛ soro na momma mo tiri so, ɛfiri sɛ mo gyeɛ rebɛn.
Borɔdɔma no ho adesua
(Mateo 24.32-35; Marko 13.28-31)
29Na ɔbuu wɔn bɛ sɛ: Monhwɛ borɔdɔma ne nnua nyinaa! 30Sɛ ɛnya fefɛ na mohwɛ a, mo ankasa mohunu sɛ ahuhuro berɛ anya abɛn. 31Saa ara na mo nso, sɛ mohunu sɛ yeinom reba a, monhunu sɛ Nyankopɔn ahennie abɛn. 32Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ yi rentwam, gye sɛ ne nyinaa aba mu ansa. 33#Luka 16.17 Ɔsoro ne asase bɛtwam, na me nsɛm deɛ, ɛrentwam da.
Kɔkɔbɔ
34 # Mar 4.19; 1 Te 5.3 Na monhwɛ mo ho yie, na adidie mmorosoɔ ne nsaborɔ ne nkwa yi mu nnoɔma ho dadwene ne haw anhyɛ mo akoma so, na ɛda no ammɛto mo mpofirim sɛ fidie, 35na ɛbɛba wɔn a wɔte asase ani nyinaa so. 36#Mar 13.33 Enti monwɛn na monsrɛ daa, na moanya ahoɔden de adwane afiri nnoɔma a ɛrebɛba yi nyinaa mu, na moakɔgyina Onipa Ba no anim.
37Nso da biara no, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ asɔrefie hɔ awia, na anadwo na wafiri hɔ akɔtena bepɔ a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔ no so. 38Na ɔman no nyinaa tua anɔpa ba ne nkyɛn asɔrefie hɔ bɛtie no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔmaa n’ani so hunuu adefoɔ a wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ regu ɛtoɔ adaka no mu. Na ɔhunuu ɔbaa kunafoɔ hiani bi nso a ɔde mpɛsewa mmienu bɛguu mu. Na ɔkaa sɛ: Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, okunafoɔ hiani yi de bebree abɛgu mu sene wɔn nyinaa. Na yeinom nyinaa firi deɛ wɔwɔ na aboro wɔn soɔ no mu na wɔde bi abɛgu mu, nanso oyi deɛ, ɔfiri ne hia mu de n’asetenadeɛ a ɔwɔ nyinaa na abɛgu mu.


Na ebinom reka asɔrefie no ho asɛm sɛdeɛ wɔde abo fɛfɛ ne akyɛdeɛ hodoɔ ahyehyɛ no no, ɔkaa sɛ: Nnoɔma a mohunu yi deɛ, nna bi bɛba a wɔrennya ɔboɔ wɔ ɔboɔ so wɔ emu a wɔrennwiri ngu fam.

Na wɔbisaa no sɛ: Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, da bɛn na yeinom bɛba, na yeinom rebɛba a, ɛho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne sɛn? Na ɔse: Monhwɛ na wɔannaadaa mo, na nnipa bebree bɛba me din mu abɛka sɛ: Mene no, na, Ɛberɛ no abɛn. Na enti monnni wɔn akyi! Na sɛ mote ɔko ne basabasayɛ a, mommma no mmɔ mo hu; na ɛtwa sɛ yeinom ba kane; nanso awieeɛ no deɛ, na ɛnnurui.

Ɛnna ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Ɔman bɛsɔre ɔman so ne ahennie ahennie so. Na asasewosoɔ kɛseɛ bɛba mmeammea, na ɛkɔm ne yaredɔm bɛba; na ahudeɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ akɛseɛ bɛfiri soro aba.

Na deɛ ɛdi yeinom nyinaa kan ne sɛ wɔde wɔn nsa bɛsɔ mo mu, na wɔataa mo, na wɔayi mo akɔ hyia adan mu ne afiase, na wɔde mo akɔ ahemfo ne amradofoɔ anim me din nti, na mode adi me ho adanseɛ.

Enti momfa nto mo tirim na moannwene deɛ mode bɛyi mo ho ano ansa. Na me na mɛma mo ano ne nyansa a mo atamfoɔ nyinaa rentumi ntua ano na wɔrennyina anim. Na awofoɔ ne anuanom ne abusuafoɔ ne nnamfo nso bɛyi mo ama, na wɔama wɔakum mo mu binom. Na me din nti nnipa nyinaa bɛtane mo. Na mo tirinwi mu biara mpo renyera. Mo boasetɔ mu na mobɛnya mo kra.

Na sɛ mohunu sɛ dɔm atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia a, ɛnneɛ monhunu sɛ ne sɛeɛ abɛn. Ɛnna momma wɔn a wɔwɔ Yudea nnwane nkɔ mmepɔ soɔ, na wɔn a wɔwɔ Yerusalem mfiri mu nkɔ, na wɔn a wɔwɔ nkuraa no, mommma wɔnnkɔ mu, ɛfiri sɛ yei ne aweretɔ nna, na nnoɔma a wɔatwerɛ no nyinaa aba mu.

Na wɔn a wɔafa afuro ne wɔn a wɔma nufoɔ nna no mu no nnue! Na ahohia kɛseɛ bɛba asase no so, na abufuo bɛda ɔman yi so. Na wɔbɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ano, na wɔafa wɔn nnommum akɔ amanaman nyinaa so. Na wiase amanaman bɛtiatia Yerusalem so de akɔsi sɛ amanaman no berɛ bɛwie duro.


Na nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bɛba owia ne ɔsrane ne nsoromma mu, na amanaman ho bɛyera wɔn asase so, ɛpo ne asorɔkyeɛ a ɛrehuro no nti; na ehu ne nnoɔma a wɔhwɛ a ɛreba wiase no bɛma nnipa atotɔ bera; ɛfiri sɛ wɔbɛwoso ɔsoro ahoɔden. Ɛnna wɔbɛhunu Onipa Ba no sɛ ɔde tumi ne animuonyam kɛseɛ reba mununkum mu. Na nnoɔma yi refiri aseɛ aba a, monhwɛ soro na momma mo tiri so, ɛfiri sɛ mo gyeɛ rebɛn.


Na ɔbuu wɔn bɛ sɛ: Monhwɛ borɔdɔma ne nnua nyinaa! Sɛ ɛnya fefɛ na mohwɛ a, mo ankasa mohunu sɛ ahuhuro berɛ anya abɛn. Saa ara na mo nso, sɛ mohunu sɛ yeinom reba a, monhunu sɛ Nyankopɔn ahennie abɛn. Nokorɛ mese mo sɛ, awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ yi rentwam, gye sɛ ne nyinaa aba mu ansa. Ɔsoro ne asase bɛtwam, na me nsɛm deɛ, ɛrentwam da.

Na monhwɛ mo ho yie, na adidie mmorosoɔ ne nsaborɔ ne nkwa yi mu nnoɔma ho dadwene ne haw anhyɛ mo akoma so, na ɛda no ammɛto mo mpofirim sɛ fidie, na ɛbɛba wɔn a wɔte asase ani nyinaa so. Enti monwɛn na monsrɛ daa, na moanya ahoɔden de adwane afiri nnoɔma a ɛrebɛba yi nyinaa mu, na moakɔgyina Onipa Ba no anim.
Nso da biara no, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ asɔrefie hɔ awia, na anadwo na wafiri hɔ akɔtena bepɔ a wɔfrɛ no Ngo Bepɔ no so. Na ɔman no nyinaa tua anɔpa ba ne nkyɛn asɔrefie hɔ bɛtie no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
